_설명: 천일문 2권 Chapter 01 문장의 주요 형식에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 기본 1과 문장의 형식 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: Dahee ______ a letter to me last Monday.

choices.text: gave
showed
sent
wrote
bought

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: Mr. Han ______ me to drink more water to stay healthy.

choices.text: told
wanted
made
ordered
advised

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: The air after the rain smells freshly.
Why does her voice sound strangely today?
Dad got a box of crayons for me.
You’d better tell your troubles for your teacher.
She decided to buy a new chair to her son.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Dad made me to practice the violin for an hour.
Yesterday, she told me stop playing games.
We heard someone to shout from the street.
The teacher ordered students be quiet in the hall.
My uncle helped me fix my bike for the trip.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 나는 나의 일본인 친구들에게 한글을 보여 주었다.
(Hangeul / my Japanese friends / showed / to / I)
questions.answer: I showed Hangeul to my Japanese friends

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 선생님은 우리에게 여기에 3시까지는 모이라고 말했다.
(meet / us / told / here / to / the teacher)
questions.answer: The teacher told us to meet here

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • Your brother looks ______(A) when he plays with his dog.
• Helmets will keep us ______(B).

choices.text: happy — safe
happy — safely
happily — safe
happily — safely
happiness — safe

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • My mom got me ______(A) at home because I had a cold.
• Our coach let us ______(B) each other.

choices.text: stay — help
stay — helping
to stay — help
to stay — to help
staying — helping

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 made와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> Mom [[made]] me clean my room today.

choices.text: I made my parents a cake for breakfast.
She made several films as a movie director.
The coach made Mia the captain of the team.
The lamp made the room bright.
Dad made me walk the dog when he was out.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문장의 전환이 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Don’t tell anyone my plan. → Don’t tell my plan to anyone.
Paul asked his teacher a question. → Paul asked a question of his teacher.
Would you get some water for me? → Would you get for me some water?
I taught my friends a new song. → I taught to my friends a new song.
Chris sent me a box from Canada. → Chris sent a box from Canada of me.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Enough sleep will make you health.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: My little brother was thirsty so he asked me bring some water.
